reorder.title: Reorder tabs
reorder.description: Drag a tab left or right to reorder it within its panel. Watch:

split.title: Create a new panel
split.description: Drag a tab out of its panel's tab bar and drop it in an empty area to create an independent panel. Watch:

combine.title: Combine panels
combine.description: Drop a tab onto another panel's header to merge them back together. Watch:

resize.title: Resize panels
resize.description: Drag any edge or corner of a panel to resize it. Watch:

snap.title: Snap to half size
snap.description: Drag a panel's header to the edge of the screen and it resizes to fill that half. Watch:

fullscreen.title: Full screen
fullscreen.description: Double-click a panel's header to expand it full screen, and again to restore it. Watch:
